summary: First smoke test of KASA cash flow app. Backend CRUD for accounts/receivables/expenses works; mark-paid correctly updates linked account balance (1000 -> 1500 after receivable paid, -> 1300 after expense paid). Frontend Dashboard, Accounts, Receivables, and Payments flows all functional with no console errors.
passed: GET /api/dashboard/summary returns balances_by_currency, pending_receivables_by_currency, pending_expenses_by_currency, overdue_by_currency, cash_flow_forecast, cash_flow_history (200)
POST /api/receivables + POST /api/receivables/{id}/mark-paid sets status=paid, paid_at, and account balance incremented by amount (currency match)
POST /api/expenses + mark-paid sets paid, decrements linked account balance
GET /api/upcoming-payments?days=30 returns 200 (empty after all items marked paid)
Frontend Dashboard loads with dashboard-container, all 4 stat cards, chart-forecast visible
Accounts page: add-account-btn opens dialog; account created and card appears
Receivables page: create + row menu + mark-paid moves item to 'Ödenen' filter
Payments page: payment-calendar visible and current day highlighted
Zero console errors during full flow
notes: Multi-currency balance guard verified in code (mark-paid only increments/decrements when account currency matches item currency). Not exhaustively tested with mismatched currencies in this pass.
